04 — Guidance

Consulting

Background

The Scholarship Roadmap

The Scholarship Roadmap was a mentorship program helping student musicians navigate the path to a music career. While the program is no longer active, Trevor accepts a limited number of consultations for musicians at a crossroads — whether you're a high school or college student exploring your options, or a working professional seeking a fresh perspective on your path.

What to Expect

Areas of Focus

01

Career Mapping

A frank conversation about what a professional music career actually looks like — the multiple income streams, the trade-offs, and the skills that matter most in today's market.

02

School & Scholarship Strategy

Guidance on selecting programs, building an audition portfolio, and navigating the financial aid landscape for music students.

03

The Working Professional

For musicians already in the industry, a second perspective on pivoting, expanding your work, or re-evaluating what success means at this stage.

Trevor accepts a limited number of consultations per quarter.
